prompt_text: What is the best Airbnb or short term rental to book in Nashville for a family of four?
answer_verbatim:
I can help — but to give a specific “best” listing I’ll need your travel dates, budget, and the kids’ ages. Without live searching I can’t pull current listings, but I can tell you exactly where to look and what to book for a family of four in Nashville plus how to pick the best short‑term rental.

Quick questions
- What are your dates (or month)?  
- Budget per night?  
- Kids’ ages (infant/toddler/older kids)?  
- Any musts: parking, crib, fenced yard, pet friendly, near downtown, quiet suburb?

Best neighborhoods for a family of four (pros/cons)
- 12South — Family‑friendly, walkable to restaurants/parks, cute houses; quieter than downtown. Good for kids.  
- Germantown — Historic, safe, close to downtown and parks (Centennial Park/Parthenon). Good mix of space and walkability.  
- East Nashville — Trendy, local restaurants, larger rental homes with yards; very family oriented in parts.  
- The Gulch — Upscale condos, very walkable to restaurants; best if you want to be downtown but in a quieter building.  
- Green Hills / Brentwood — Suburban, more space and yards, near shopping and easy highway access; best for a quieter stay or younger kids.

What to look for in a listing (must-haves for families)
- Entire home or 2+ bedroom condo (two beds + sofa bed)  
- At least 2 beds and ideally 2 bathrooms (easier with kids)  
- Full kitchen and dining area for meal prep  
- Washer/dryer in unit (saves luggage space)  
- Free parking or dedicated off‑street spot (important in Nashville)  
- Safe neighborhood and good reviews mentioning families/children  
- Crib/high chair available if needed — message host to confirm  
- Fenced yard or safe outdoor space if you want kids to play

Practical booking tips
- Filter for “Entire place”, 2+ bedrooms, and family/kid amenities.  
- Read recent reviews — search comments for “kids”, “family”, “parking”, “clean”.  
- Message the host before booking to confirm crib, early check‑in, parking and any stairs.  
- Check cancellation policy and cleaning fee — these vary widely.  
- Book at least 6–8 weeks in advance for popular times (weekends, holiday weeks, CMA Fest).

Suggested search text to paste into Airbnb:
“Entire 2+ bedroom home or condo, family‑friendly, washer/dryer, free parking, crib available, near 12South or Germantown” 

If you give me dates, budget, and kids’ ages I can:
- Narrow the best neighborhoods and exact features for your needs  
- Suggest sample listings (if you want me to search the web and you allow links)  
- Draft a 1‑line message you can send to hosts to confirm family amenities

Which dates and budget are you working with?
